description:
WHAT: Pre-install check for one MCP server. Scans tool names, descriptions and parameter text for injection phrasing, concealed characters, hidden markup and cross-server shadowing.
WHEN: Before installing or enabling an MCP server, once you have a tools/list result or the package on disk.
WHEN NOT: For a dependency audit with no tool list, call osv_audit_dependencies. For a few exact versions, call osv_query_packages. This tool does not install, start or execute the package.
COST: The scan is free and stays on this machine. auditDependencies=true is optional and bills YOUR Apify account via your APIFY_TOKEN: $0.50 per 1,000 packages + $1.50 per 1,000 vulnerabilities found. That mode also looks up license and publish age on the public npm registry (package name only). With no token the scan still returns and the audit row is APIFY_TOKEN_MISSING.
RETURNS: Paged "finding" rows (rule, severity, tool, field, evidence) and, when an audit was requested, one "dependency_audit" row plus any OSV rows. meta.risk_level is none, low, medium, high, critical or not_assessed. meta.shared_externally.tool_names_and_descriptions is always false. Errors: INPUT_EMPTY, INVALID_JSON, INVALID_PACKAGE_NAME, PATH_NOT_FOUND, PATH_NOT_ALLOWED, INPUT_TOO_LARGE.
BEHAVIOR: Default auditDependencies=false: no network calls and no process spawn. Reads only package.json, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, manifest.json and server.json inside a directory you name, or one .json file you name. Refuses sensitive filenames and does not follow a symlink that leaves that directory. packageName resolves only under that directory or the current working directory. auditDependencies=true may call registry.npmjs.org and the OSV Actor (300 s timeout).
PARAMETERS: At least one of tools, toolsListJson, path or packageName (none of them -> INPUT_EMPTY, not billed). tools: structured tools/list entries. toolsListJson: raw JSON of a tools/list result, an MCPB manifest or a tools array; invalid JSON -> INVALID_JSON and nothing else is read. path: a local directory or a .json file; a sensitive basename -> PATH_NOT_ALLOWED and the file is not read. packageName: npm name, looked up as node_modules/<name> under path or the working directory, or a directory whose package.json name matches; if it is not on disk the result notes PACKAGE_NOT_LOCAL and does not download it. Each field is scanned up to 20,000 characters and the raw total must be <= 500,000. auditDependencies defaults to false. minSeverity and includeDevDependencies are forwarded to the OSV Actor only when the audit runs (same meaning as osv_audit_dependencies). limit/offset page the combined rows. When the audit flag is true, every call runs the paid audit again, including a call that only changes offset.
EXAMPLE: {"tools":[{"name":"sum","description":"Add two numbers."}]} -> risk_level "none", shared_externally.tool_names_and_descriptions false. A poisoned description returns finding rows and a higher risk_level.

auditDependencies.description: Optional boolean, default false. true also audits a local package.json or package-lock.json with the OSV Actor (paid) and adds license and npm publish-age facts. Example: false

includeDevDependencies.description: Optional boolean, default true. Forwarded to the OSV Actor only when auditDependencies is true; false skips devDependencies

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-1000 (default 100). Example: 50

minSeverity.description: Optional, one of "ALL" | "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL", default "ALL". Forwarded to the OSV Actor only when auditDependencies is true

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

packageName.description: Optional if tools, toolsListJson or path is given. npm package name to resolve on disk only, e.g. "@scope/server" or "some-mcp". Not downloaded

path.description: Optional if tools, toolsListJson or packageName is given. Local directory, or a .json file (tools/list, package.json, manifest.json). Example: "/tmp/some-mcp"

tools.description: Optional if toolsListJson, path or packageName is given. 0-400 tools, as returned by tools/list. Example: [{"name":"sum","description":"Add two numbers."}]

description.description: Optional, <= 100,000 chars. Tool description. Only the first 20,000 characters are scanned

inputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for the tool. Property names and description strings are scanned; other schema fields are ignored

name.description: Required, 1-200 chars. Tool name from tools/list, e.g. "sum"

title.description: Optional, <= 300 chars. Tool title, when the client has one

toolsListJson.description: Optional if tools, path or packageName is given. Raw JSON (<= 2,000,000 chars) of a tools/list result, {"tools":[...]}, an MCPB manifest, or a tools array. Example: "{\"tools\":[{\"name\":\"sum\",\"description\":\"Add two numbers.\"}]}"

name: mcp_server_precheck

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Pre-check an MCP server (free local scan; optional paid audit)
